method: pyte 140x45 screen over a real `claude` TUI in a pty, started with an EMPTY CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR so it shows its first-run login flow, with `open`/`xdg-open`/BROWSER shimmed so no browser launched. Keys sent as raw bytes: Return on the theme picker, then Return on '1. Claude account with subscription'. No code was ever pasted and no login completed.
sanitized: login-paste-code.captured.txt is otherwise verbatim, but the `code_challenge` and `state` query values of the on-screen URL were replaced with same-length placeholders (FAKE-code-challenge-PLACEHOLDER-*, FAKE-state-PLACEHOLDER-*) so no live OAuth attempt is committed. Same length, so the hard-wrap columns are unchanged. The first screen line ('uWelcometo Claude Code') is pyte's rendering of the welcome banner's title, kept as captured.

screens.login-theme-picker.captured.txt: First-run theme picker. Rows are drawn `❯ ✔ Dark mode` with NO numbers: not a list ChoiceDialog reads, and deliberately not widened to.
screens.login-method.captured.txt: `Select login method:` - three numbered rows, cursor on row 0.
screens.login-paste-code.captured.txt: After choosing row 0: the browser-did-not-open screen. The URL is hard-wrapped at the 140-column width with no spaces; its redirect_uri is platform.claude.com's code page, not localhost.
